question: Which 3 variants are most strongly enriched in East Asians relative to Europeans?
sql:
SELECT v.chrom, v.pos, v.ref, v.alt FROM variants v
JOIN populations p ON v.population = p.population
JOIN genotypes g ON v.id = g.variant_id
JOIN samples s ON g.sample_id = s.sample_id
JOIN variant_genes vg ON v.id = vg.variant_id
JOIN genes g2 ON vg.gene_id = g2.gene_id
WHERE p.population_name = 'East Asian' AND g2.eur_af IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY v.chrom, v.pos, v.ref, v.alt
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN s.sex = 'F' THEN g.allele_count ELSE 0 END) / SUM(g.allele_count) DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: Among variants with frequency above 50% in Africans, what proportion also exceed 50% in Europeans?
sql:
SELECT 
    v.chrom, 
    v.pos, 
    v.ref, 
    v.alt, 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN v.eur_af > 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) / COUNT(*) AS proportion_eur_af_above_50
FROM 
    variants v
JOIN 
    populations p ON v.population = p.population
WHERE 
    p.population_name = 'African'
GROUP BY 
    v.chrom, 
    v.pos, 
    v.ref, 
    v.alt;

question: Which 1-Mb window of chr22 contains the most singletons? Give the window start position and the count.
sql:
SELECT 
    chrom, 
    pos, 
    ref, 
    alt, 
    COUNT(*) AS singleton_count
FROM 
    variants
WHERE 
    chrom = 'chr22' 
    AND pos BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000
GROUP BY 
    chrom, 
    pos, 
    ref, 
    alt
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) = 1
ORDER BY 
    singleton_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which super-population has the most private variants, and how many?
sql:
SELECT p.super_population_name, COUNT(v.id) AS private_variant_count
FROM populations p
JOIN samples s ON p.population = s.population
JOIN variants v ON s.sample_id = v.sample_id
WHERE v.is_multiallelic = TRUE
GROUP BY p.super_population_name
ORDER BY private_variant_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which gene has the most pathogenic ClinVar variants, and how many does it have?
sql:
SELECT g.gene_name, COUNT(c.id) AS pathogenic_count
FROM genes g
JOIN variant_genes vg ON g.gene_id = vg.gene_id
JOIN clinvar c ON vg.variant_id = c.variation_id
WHERE c.is_pathogenic = TRUE
GROUP BY g.gene_name
ORDER BY pathogenic_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which pathogenic ClinVar variants are more than 1 percentage point more frequent in Africans than in Europeans?
sql:
SELECT v.chrom, v.pos, v.ref, v.alt, c.clinical_significance, c.significance_class, c.is_pathogenic, c.review_status, c.review_stars, c.conditions, c.variant_class, c.consequences, c.origin, p.population_name, p.super_population_name
FROM variants v
JOIN clinvar c ON v.id = c.variation_id
JOIN populations p ON v.population = p.population
WHERE c.is_pathogenic = TRUE
  AND v.af > (SELECT AVG(eur_af) FROM variants WHERE af > 0 AND population = 'EUR')
  AND v.af > (SELECT AVG(afr_af) FROM variants WHERE af > 0 AND population = 'AFR');

question: Which protein-coding gene contains the most 1000 Genomes variants, and how many?
sql:
SELECT g.gene_name, COUNT(v.id) AS variant_count
FROM genes g
JOIN variant_genes vg ON g.gene_id = vg.gene_id
JOIN variants v ON vg.variant_id = v.id
WHERE g.biotype = 'protein_coding'
GROUP BY g.gene_name
ORDER BY variant_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: How many rare 1000 Genomes variants are located in CHEK2?
